preconditions.expression: T == int(stdin.split()[0]) and T >= 1 and T <= 1000
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 1000) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(len(A) == N and len(B) == N for N, A, B in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the strings A and B have length N, where N is the number of stones each player has.

preconditions.expression: all(A.islower() and B.islower() for A, B in test_cases)
preconditions.description: All characters in strings A and B are lowercase letters.

preconditions.expression: sum(N for N, A, B in test_cases) <= 2 * 10**5
preconditions.description: The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(len(S) == 2 * N for N, A, B, S in zip(test_cases, stdout.strip().split()))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output string S has length 2 * N.

postconditions.expression: all(all(c in A + B for c in S) for N, A, B, S in zip(test_cases, stdout.strip().split()))
postconditions.description: Every character in S is present in the combined stones of Alice and Bob.

postconditions.expression: all(all(S.count(c) == (A.count(c) + B.count(c)) for c in set(A + B)) for N, A, B, S in zip(test_cases, stdout.strip().split()))
postconditions.description: The frequency of each character in S matches the combined frequency of that character in A and B.

postconditions.expression: all(not any(S[i] < S[j] and i > j for i in range(2 * N) for j in range(i)) for N, A, B, S in zip(test_cases, stdout.strip().split()))
postconditions.description: The string S is lexicographically minimal possible when Alice plays optimally to minimize it and Bob plays optimally to maximize it.
